materials.title: Reference violet clay
materials.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production seamless albedo texture for a new detailed 3D voxel cottage matched to an existing storybook concept.
Primary request: one flat square swatch of rich blue-violet, hand-glazed clay. Muted indigo-purple midtones, subtle lavender scumbling, tiny warm terracotta pinholes, a few broad irregular brush strokes and smooth pooled glaze. The surface of ONE ceramic shingle, without drawing a shingle shape or a grid. This will wrap individual physically modeled chunky roof tiles with separate curved bevels; all shape, tile joints, edge highlights and cast shadows come from 3D geometry.
Style: beautifully hand-painted fantasy game material, bold simple painterly detail that remains legible at 128 pixels, restrained low contrast, richer and darker than pale lavender. Medium value, not black.
Composition: material fills the whole square. Perfectly straight-on orthographic material scan, uniform diffuse neutral lighting, no lighting gradients, no vignette, no perspective, no objects, no tile grid, no border, no text, no watermark.
Constraints: seamless left/right and top/bottom edges, opaque. Do not add any decorative pattern, cracks, scratches, grout or baked bevel shading.
materials.usage: Original concept cottage reconstruction; per-mesh UVs.

materials.title: Reference honey oak
materials.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production seamless albedo texture for the thick honey-oak log courses of a detailed 3D cottage in a cozy voxel fantasy village.
Primary request: a flat square swatch of warm, old golden chestnut oak, with long hand-painted flowing wood grain moving HORIZONTALLY from left to right. Caramel and amber midtones, softly darker ochre grain, a few elongated restrained knots, subtle golden brush marks. Crafted weathered wood that feels cared for, not damaged. No planks or seams: the actual 3D building supplies separate broad log courses, bevels, corner joints and shadows.
Style: beautifully painted storybook gouache game material, broad legible organic grain with sparse finer marks, restrained contrast and moderate saturation; warm toasted honey, never pale tan or orange stripes.
Composition: uninterrupted material filling the entire square, perfectly orthographic straight-on, flat diffuse neutral illumination. No perspective, no directional light, no cast shadows or painted edge shadows, no bevels, vignette, border, text or watermark.
Constraints: truly seamless in both axes. Opaque. No wood planks, log ends, checkerboard, tile grid, gashes or photorealistic photographic grain.
materials.usage: Original concept cottage reconstruction; per-mesh UVs.

materials.title: Reference cream limestone
materials.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless opaque albedo texture for small hand-dressed limestone blocks in a detailed cozy voxel fantasy cottage.
Primary request: ONE flat square material swatch of warm pale cream limestone. Ivory and oatmeal midtones with gentle pale honey variation, small broad cloudy brush patches, sparse tiny ochre pores and a few very subtle irregular mineral flecks. The actual 3D model supplies separate beveled stones, joints, a rounded doorway arch and steps; this image is only the surface of one stone, not masonry.
Style: careful hand-painted storybook gouache, calm and clean, stylized fantasy game material. Warm luminous cream, not white plastic or cold gray concrete. Broad restrained marks legible after reduction to 128 pixels. Low contrast with no prominent isolated blotch.
Composition: material fills entire square, perfectly straight-on flat orthographic swatch, neutral even diffuse illumination. No directional light, no cast shadows, no vignette, no edge highlights or fake ambient occlusion.
Constraints: truly seamless in both axes; no blocks, bricks, stone outlines, mortar, cracks, veins, borders, labels, text, grid, spheres, perspective or watermark. No photographic surface noise.
materials.usage: Per-stone surfaces on arch, plinth, treads, chimney and planter.
